name: Workmates Core2Cloud Solution Ltd
tagline: Kolkata BSE-SME AWS Premier-Tier cloud MSP growing ~34% with 82% recurring revenue — but a thin-margin, AWS-dependent intermediary with declining margins, priced at ~28x off a +90% listing pop and an aggressive FY27 guide
business_overview: Workmates Core2Cloud (incorporated 2018, BSE-SME listed Nov 2025) is a Premier-Tier AWS Consulting Partner providing cloud and digital-transformation services — migration, modernisation, security, managed services — to enterprises across finance, healthcare, retail, e-commerce and media. 350+ projects for 200+ clients. Revenue is ~82.5% recurring (managed services) and ~17.5% project implementation.
fundamentals_table: Revenue Rs 143 Cr (+33.6% YoY); PAT Rs 15.9 Cr (~11.1% margin)
Gross 32.8% (vs 33.9% FY25); EBITDA 16.2% (vs 17.7%); PAT 11.1% (vs 13.0%) — all compressing
Rs 210 Cr revenue (~+47%) on AI / cloud / cybersecurity
IPO Nov 2025 at Rs 200-204; listed at Rs 387.60 (+90%)
fundamentals_narrative: Real growth and profitability for an SME — 34% revenue growth, 11% PAT margin, high recurring mix, low debt. But the model is a thin-margin intermediary sitting on top of AWS: gross, EBITDA and PAT margins all stepped down year-on-year, the economics depend on AWS partner terms and incentives, and AWS can disintermediate or re-tier partners at will. The FY27 guide (Rs 210 Cr, +47%) is aggressive against a decelerating-margin backdrop, and the stock is priced off a +90% listing pop.
technical_read: Listed Nov 2025 at a ~90% premium; thin SME liquidity.
sentiment_summary: No ValuePickr thread exists (forum search returned nothing). The lead is from an untrusted X handle (@arvind_kothari-adjacent triage batch). No community validation. Available third-party commentary frames FY26 as recurring-led growth with a margin dip and 'a bigger FY27 ask'.
community_signal: None (no VP thread; untrusted X lead only).
bse_notes: No SEBI/fraud order; no going-concern issue. BSE-SME listing — lighter disclosure and governance regime, thin float. Transformed private -> public in early 2025 shortly before the IPO.
bull_case: 34% revenue growth with an 82.5% recurring mix and ~11% PAT margin; low debt
Premier-Tier AWS partner status; exposure to Indian enterprise cloud, AI and cybersecurity adoption
200+ clients across diversified verticals; management guiding to Rs 210 Cr FY27 revenue
bear_case: Thin-margin AWS-dependent intermediary; gross/EBITDA/PAT margins all declined YoY
No moat — AWS partner tier is replicable, customer switching costs are low, and AWS/Redington/Ingram-type players can disintermediate
~28x FY26 earnings / 3.3x sales priced off a +90% listing pop and an aggressive (+47%) FY27 guide
BSE-SME (thin liquidity, lighter governance); lead is from an untrusted X handle

four_box.note: tailwind weak (Indian cloud/AI spend is growing, but Workmates captures a thin, contestable slice). tam weak (Rs 441 Cr mcap; cloud-MSP services TAM is large but fragmented and margin-poor; 10x on a reseller model is not credible). moat no (AWS partner tier replicable; disintermediation risk). valuation weak (~28x / 3.3x sales for an 11%-margin, margin-declining reseller). Score 1.5 -> neither, hard.

verdict_reasoning: External-lead (tier 4.5) from an untrusted X handle. four_box score 1.5 -> thesis_fit 'neither', hard. Genuine SME growth and profitability, but a thin-margin, AWS-dependent intermediary with declining margins and no moat, priced at ~28x off a +90% listing pop with an aggressive FY27 guide.
Conviction Low-Medium: profitable and growing, which clears 'Low', but the structural position (reseller economics, disintermediation risk, SME governance/liquidity) and the valuation cap it.
No VP thread (web-only). Not a genuine 'US + Indian software / product-SaaS turn' theme play — Workmates is a services reseller, not a product/ARR company. No red_flag_tier. No revisit flag.
